abstract: This study examines how multidimensional sustainability-related conditions, together with institutional quality, are associated with total factor productivity (TFP) across countries operating at different productivity levels. Using a balanced panel of BRICS, OECD, and Asian economies covering the period 2000–2022, we construct a composite sustainability indicator encompassing economic, environmental, social, and governance (EESG) dimensions, alongside standard macroeconomic controls. To allow the relationship to differ across the productivity distribution, we apply the Method of Moments Quantile Regression (MMQR) estimator. The results reveal clear heterogeneity across both regions and productivity levels. In OECD economies, stronger associations between sustainability-related conditions and productivity are observed at higher productivity quantiles, particularly for institutional quality and economic stability. In BRICS and Asian economies, the association varies more across quantiles, with economic and social dimensions playing a larger role in the lower and middle parts of the TFP distribution. Environmental dimensions exhibit weaker and more mixed short-run associations in some specifications, a pattern that is consistent with transitional adjustment dynamics but does not preclude longer-run productivity benefits. The findings indicate that sustainability–productivity linkages are context-dependent, with institutional capacity and stage of development shaping the extent to which sustainability-related conditions are associated with productivity performance.
title: Sustainability, Institutions, and Productivity: A Cross-Country Quantile Analysis of Economic, Environmental, Social, and Governance Index and Total Factor Productivity
title_zh: 可持续性、制度与生产率：经济、环境、社会及治理指数与全要素生产率的跨国分位数分析

abstract: Decades of intensive fertilizer application have led to the accumulation of phosphorus in cropland soils across the US. An empirical question is: Why does fertilizer use remain high even in the presence of large soil phosphorus stocks? A previously proposed hypothesis is that farmers lack sufficient information about soil phosphorus, and that enhanced testing could reduce fertilizer use. We evaluate this argument using a dynamic farm‐level optimization model with imperfectly observed soil phosphorus and costly testing. We parameterize the model using data from corn field trials spanning over a decade in eastern North Carolina. To account for uncertain soil phosphorus beliefs and the value of information from testing, we structure our model as a “partial‐observability Markov decision process,” accounting for and investigating the roles of fertilizer price volatility, farmer risk aversion, and intertemporal preferences. Simulation results show that information from enhanced soil testing is most valuable at low levels of soil phosphorus, enabling profit‐maximizing farmers to dynamically tailor their subsequent fertilizer inputs with more accurate soil phosphorus measurements. However, when legacy soil phosphorus is high, enhanced testing does not reduce optimal fertilizer inputs, contrary to the hypothesis we set out to investigate. Sensitivity analysis identifies important biophysical and economic factors that shape farmer fertilizer and soil testing decisions in the model. To our knowledge, this work reflects the first dynamic analysis of the economics of soil nutrient testing. We discuss implications of these dynamics for policies seeking to reduce environmental externalities from phosphorus fertilizer use.
title: Evaluating optimal farm management of phosphorus fertilizer inputs with partial observability of legacy soil stocks
title_zh: 评估在遗留土壤库存部分可观测条件下的磷肥投入最优农场管理

abstract: University laboratory samples often produce cleaner experimental data than broader online samples such as Prolific. We examine whether this gap reflects differences in the opportunity cost of time. In an experiment spanning laboratory and online participant pools, we exogenously vary both the cost of deliberation and task complexity. Online participants are faster and less accurate at baseline. Raising time costs in the laboratory lowers accuracy, while reducing the return to answering quickly online improves it. Participant-pool differences arise where deliberation is both costly and productive, linking external validity to experimental design and task complexity.
abstract_zh: 大学实验室样本通常比Prolific等更广泛的在线样本产生更干净的实验数据。我们考察这一差距是否反映了时间机会成本的差异。在一项涵盖实验室和在线参与者池的实验中，我们外生变化了 deliberation 的成本和任务复杂度。在线参与者在基线条件下更快且准确性更低。提高实验室中的时间成本会降低准确性，而降低在线快速作答的回报则会提高准确性。参与者池差异出现在 deliberation 既有成本又有产出之处，将外部效度与实验设计和任务复杂度联系起来。
title: Time Costs and Behaviour Across Participant Pools
title_zh: 参与者群体中的时间成本与行为

abstract: Low Emission Zones (LEZs)---urban areas that exclude vehicles failing to meet certain environmental standards---have become increasingly prominent. Yet little is known about their optimal design: which vehicles to restrict, on what timetable, and over how large an area. Unlike price-based instruments, LEZs ration access inefficiently: their welfare cost is also borne by inframarginal drivers of restricted vehicles. As a result, welfare is quasi-convex in LEZ size, yielding three bang-bang design principles: (i) the LEZ should be either as large as politically feasible or, if it falls below a minimum scale, not implemented at all; (ii) less polluting vehicles, such as hybrids, should be treated as transition technologies---temporarily exempt, but later subject to the same restrictions as dirtier vehicles, and (iii) these later restrictions, which must be announced in advance, require commitment from the planner. We use data on new-car prices and purchases to assess Madrid's LEZ through the lens of this bang-bang logic. The policy shifted buyers toward cleaner cars, but the surplus lost by inframarginal drivers outweighed the gains from the emissions saved by the switchers.
abstract_zh: 低排放区（LEZs）——即禁止不符合特定环境标准的车辆进入的城市区域——已日益普遍。然而，人们对其最优设计知之甚少：限制哪些车辆、按何种时间表实施、覆盖多大范围。与基于价格的工具不同，低排放区对通行权的配给是低效的：其福利成本也由受限制车辆的边际内驾驶者承担。因此，福利关于低排放区规模呈准凸性，从而得出三条“砰-砰”（bang-bang）设计原则：（i）低排放区要么应尽可能大到政治可行，要么若低于最低规模则根本不应实施；（ii）污染较少的车辆（如混合动力车）应被视为过渡技术——暂时豁免，但随后应受到与更脏车辆相同的限制；（iii）这些后续限制必须提前公布，并需要规划者的承诺。我们利用新车价格和购买数据，以这种“砰-砰”逻辑为视角评估马德里的低排放区。该政策促使购车者转向更清洁的汽车，但边际内驾驶者损失的剩余超过了转向者所减少排放带来的收益。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为马德里低排放区，数据与政策背景均为西班牙，不涉及中国。
title: Designing Low Emission Zones: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 设计低排放区：理论与证据

abstract: This paper examines the long-term impacts of colonial-period railroads on agricultural productivity in sub-Saharan Africa. Using granular data from 22 countries, we show that historically rail-connected regions remain more productive today. We also find that these regions are more integrated into modern road-based urban markets. We interpret this pattern as evidence of path-dependent spatial equilibrium, where early investment in the transportation network helped coordinate the location of economic activities in the post-colonial period. However, the evidence does not rule out the possibility that colonial railways and the modern road network both followed persistent favorable geographic fundamentals. More broadly, the findings show how early transport investment can leave durable effects on rural development by shaping the geography of market access.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了殖民时期铁路对撒哈拉以南非洲农业生产率的长期影响。利用来自22个国家的细粒度数据，我们表明，历史上与铁路相连的地区今天仍然更具生产力。我们还发现，这些地区更好地融入了以现代公路为基础的城市市场。我们将这一模式解释为路径依赖的空间均衡的证据，即早期对交通网络的投资有助于协调后殖民时期经济活动的区位。然而，这些证据并不能排除这样一种可能性：殖民铁路和现代公路网络都遵循了持续有利的地理基本面。更广泛地说，这些发现表明，早期交通投资如何通过塑造市场可达性的地理格局，对农村发展产生持久影响。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: The persistent legacy: Colonial railroads and agricultural productivity in Africa
title_zh: 持久的遗产：非洲殖民时期的铁路与农业生产率

abstract: After a pause in statutory minimum wage increases during the Great Recession, several states increased minimum wages since 2010, including increases as large as 60% over just a few years. Using a triple difference-in-differences framework and data on the universe of births from 2010 to 2019, this study investigates how recent minimum wage hikes affected birth outcomes. We first document sizeable negative impacts of minimum wage policy on the labor supply and economic well-being of females aged 16-44. We then document small adverse effects on birth outcomes, estimating that minimum wage increases led to lower birthweight, fewer normal birthweight births, and more small for gestational age births. These findings generally contrast with an earlier literature relying primarily on much smaller minimum wage increases which showed more evidence of positive impacts on birth outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在大衰退期间法定最低工资增长暂停之后，几个州自2010年起提高了最低工资，其中一些州在短短几年内增幅高达60%。本研究采用三重差分框架，并使用2010年至2019年全量出生数据，考察近期最低工资上调如何影响出生结果。我们首先记录了最低工资政策对16—44岁女性的劳动供给和经济福祉产生了相当大的负面影响。随后我们记录了其对出生结果的少量不利影响，估计最低工资上调导致出生体重降低、正常出生体重出生数减少，以及小于胎龄儿出生数增加。这些发现总体上与早期文献形成对比，后者主要依赖幅度小得多的最低工资上调，并显示出更多关于出生结果受到积极影响的证据。
title: Recent Minimum Wage Policy and Its Impacts on Birth Outcomes
title_zh: 近期最低工资政策及其对出生结果的影响

abstract: This paper develops a hybrid nonlinear solution method for large-scale dynamic macroeconomic models, combining insights from the deep learning literature with the strengths of traditional perturbation and projection techniques. The method embeds economically motivated functional forms and perturbation-based derivatives within an approximation that uses deep function composition. Applied to a large OLG model with borrowing constraints and multiple aggregate shocks, the solution method achieves high accuracy over a wide range of the relevant state space.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于大规模动态宏观经济模型的混合非线性求解方法，将深度学习文献中的洞见与传统扰动法和投影法的优势相结合。该方法在采用深度函数复合的近似框架内，嵌入了具有经济动机的函数形式以及基于扰动的导数。将该方法应用于一个包含借贷约束和多重总体冲击的大型世代交叠模型，求解方法在相关状态空间的广泛范围内实现了高精度。

abstract: A computer program calculates a pair of infinite sequences of money creation and price level inflation rates ( θ → , μ → ) that maximizes a benevolent time 0 government’s objective function. The limit of a monotonically declining sequence of continuation values is a worst continuation value associated with a “timeless perspective”. The time-invariant inflation rate associated with the worst continuation Ramsey plan is not the inflation rate associated with a restricted Ramsey plan in which a time 0 government is constrained to choose a time-invariant money creation rate. We Bellmanize the continuation Ramsey problem.
abstract_zh: 一个计算机程序计算出一对无限序列的货币创造率和价格水平通胀率 ( θ → , μ → )，以最大化仁慈的0期政府的目标函数。单调递减的延续值序列的极限是与“永恒视角”相关的最差延续值。与最差延续拉姆齐计划相关的时间不变通胀率，并不等同于在受限拉姆齐计划中，0期政府被约束选择时间不变货币创造率时所对应的通胀率。我们对延续拉姆齐问题进行贝尔曼化处理。

abstract: Populists govern more of the world’s countries than at any point in the past century, on both the right and the left. What they share is not an economic programme but a worldview that casts politics as a struggle between ordinary citizens and a self-serving establishment, a conflict that is zero-sum at its core. We show that exposure to this political environment leaves a durable imprint on citizens’ beliefs. Combining data on populist leaders with surveys of more than 260,000 respondents in 53 countries, we exploit within-country-survey-year variation across birth cohorts and find that greater exposure during early adulthood is associated with stronger zero- sum beliefs later in life. The result is replicated in two independent surveys and across multiple measures of zero-sum thinking and perceived economic conflict and persists into respondents’ mid-forties. The associations extend to voting intentions: exposure does not predict support for populist parties overall, but it does predict support for ideologically extreme parties aligned with the populist rule experienced in early adulthood. The mechanism evidence provides little support for an economic-scarcity explanation and instead points towards a rhetorical channel, as populist rule features substantially more anti-elite rhetoric in two independent measures and more domestic zero-sum framing in United Nations speeches.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义者在右翼和左翼同时执政的国家数量超过了过去一个世纪的任何时期。他们的共同点并非某种经济纲领，而是一种世界观，将政治视为普通公民与自私自利的建制派之间的斗争，其核心是零和冲突。我们表明，暴露于这种政治环境会在公民信念中留下持久印记。我们将民粹主义领导人的数据与53个国家超过26万名受访者的调查数据相结合，利用国内调查年度中不同出生队列之间的变异，发现成年早期更大程度的暴露与日后生活中更强的零和信念相关。这一结果在两项独立调查中得到复现，并在多种零和思维与感知经济冲突的衡量指标上成立，且持续到受访者四十多岁中期。这些关联还延伸至投票意向：暴露并不能整体预测对民粹主义政党的支持，但确实能预测对与成年早期所经历的民粹主义统治在意识形态上一致的极端政党的支持。机制证据几乎不支持经济稀缺解释，而是指向一种修辞渠道，因为民粹主义统治在两项独立衡量指标中都表现出明显更多的反精英修辞，在联合国演讲中也表现出更多国内零和框架。
title: Populist Rule and the Formation of Zero-Sum Beliefs
title_zh: 民粹统治与零和信念的形成

abstract: We study how intergroup contact among immigrants shapes national identity formation within migrant communities and in their places of origin. We assemble a new dataset on Italian migrants to the U.S. between 1892 and 1924 by linking population census records to Ellis Island passenger lists, which report migrants’ municipalities of origin. In the U.S., exposure to more diverse Italian communities fosters shared national identity, as measured by national naming choices and intergroup marriage, while reducing assimilation into American society. In Italy, municipalities whose migrants were exposed to more diverse communities abroad exhibit lower cultural particularism. Our findings uncover a nation-building effect of intergroup contact within immigrant communities, extending from immigrant communities abroad to migrants’ places of origin.
abstract_zh: 我们研究移民之间的群体间接触如何塑造移民社区内部及其原籍地的国家认同形成。我们通过将人口普查记录与埃利斯岛乘客名单相链接，构建了一个关于1892年至1924年间意大利移民美国的新数据集，该名单记录了移民的原籍市镇。在美国，接触更多元化的意大利社区促进了共享的国家认同，这以国家命名选择和群体间通婚来衡量，同时降低了同化进入美国社会的程度。在意大利，其移民在国外接触过更多元化社区的市镇表现出更低的文化特殊主义。我们的发现揭示了移民社区内部群体间接触的国家建构效应，这一效应从国外的移民社区延伸至移民的原籍地。
title: A Nation of Emigrants: Transatlantic Emigration and Italian National Identity
title_zh: 移民之国：跨大西洋移民与意大利国家认同

abstract: In this chapter, we discuss how immigration affects identity, with implications for politics. We build on key insights from social psychology and their formalization in economics to derive predictions about how immigration changes both self-identification and categorization of others into groups. These immigration-induced identity changes can explain two recent political transformations that have characterized many Western democracies: the rise of right-wing populism and the realignment of voters and parties along a socio-cultural, rather than economic, dimension of political conflict. We also discuss how immigration can reshape group boundaries and political cleavages, depending on the characteristics of immigrants, host populations, and the local context. We highlight open questions and possible directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 在本章中，我们讨论移民如何影响身份认同，并探讨其对政治的影响。我们基于社会心理学的关键洞见及其在经济学中的形式化，推导出关于移民如何改变自我认同以及如何将他人归类为群体的预测。这些由移民引发的身份认同变化，可以解释近年来许多西方民主国家所经历的两大政治转变：右翼民粹主义的兴起，以及选民和政党沿着社会文化维度而非经济维度进行的政治冲突重组。我们还讨论移民如何重塑群体边界和政治分歧，这取决于移民的特征、东道国人口以及当地情境。我们强调尚未解决的问题以及未来研究的可能方向。
title: Migration, identity and political economy in a globalizing world
title_zh: 全球化世界中的移民、身份认同与政治经济学

abstract: Classic finance theory advises investors to hold a mix of the risk-free asset and a single portfolio of risky assets: the tangency portfolio that maximizes the Sharpe ratio. Two questions about this ad- vice have remained largely unresolved. Is holding this specific portfolio approximately consistent with expected utility maximization? And if so, what determines how much of it to hold? Existing derivations typically assume either Normally distributed returns or quadratic utility. This paper answers both questions using a second-order expansion of a general concave utility function, without either restriction. The resulting portfolio is exactly proportional to the tangency portfolio, scaled by a term that depends on the maximum Sharpe ratio of the investment opportunity set. The approximation is highly accurate: a fourth-order correction, solved exactly for a two-asset opportunity set and numerically for a ten-asset one, changes portfolio composition only modestly, and the solution captures at least 95% of the achievable utility gain, relative to the numerically optimal CRRA portfolio, over a naive benchmark matched to the same overall risky/risk-free split.
abstract_zh: 经典金融理论建议投资者持有无风险资产与单一风险资产组合的混合：即最大化夏普比率的切点组合。关于这一建议的两个问题在很大程度上仍未解决。持有这一特定组合是否近似符合期望效用最大化？如果是，又是什么决定了应持有多少？现有推导通常假设收益呈正态分布或效用为二次型。本文利用一般凹效用函数的二阶展开回答这两个问题，且不施加上述任一限制。所得组合恰好与切点组合成比例，并按一个取决于投资机会集最大夏普比率的项进行缩放。该近似高度精确：对于两资产机会集精确求解、对于十资产机会集数值求解的四阶修正，仅温和改变组合构成，并且相对于在相同整体风险/无风险配置下匹配的朴素基准，该解至少捕捉到相对于数值最优CRRA组合可实现效用增益的95%。
title: Expected Utility Maximization and the Optimal Portfolio of Risky Assets
title_zh: 期望效用最大化与风险资产的最优投资组合

abstract: I examine how individuals update their environmental attitudes in response to climate events using the extensive Swedish forest fires in 2018. Political scientists have suggested that motivated reasoning contributes to divergence in environmental attitudes over time. It remains empirically unclear whether the growing prominence of climate events could potentially widen or bridge these political divides. I document rising environmental concerns following the fires. The extent of these increases did not appear to be associated with the intensity of local fires but varied significantly by individuals’ prior beliefs. Green-left-leaning individuals exhibited stronger prior concerns and showed larger increases in concern after the fires than conservative-right-leaning individuals. The growing concern suggests that climate events exacerbate political polarization in environmental attitudes rather than mitigating it. I also find no evidence that exposure to climate change news explains the observed political polarization in concerns. These patterns are consistent with motivated reasoning along partisan lines shaping differential reactions to climate disasters. In contrast, I do not find similar patterns for support for a higher carbon tax, indicating that increased concern does not necessarily translate into support for climate policy. abstract_zh: 我利用2018年瑞典大规模森林火灾，考察个体如何随气候事件更新其环境态度。政治学者提出，动机性推理会随时间推移导致环境态度出现分化。气候事件日益突出究竟可能扩大还是弥合这些政治分歧，在实证上仍不清楚。我记录了火灾之后环境关切上升的现象。这种上升幅度似乎与当地火灾强度无关，却因个体先前信念不同而存在显著差异。偏绿左的个体原本关切更强，火灾后关切上升幅度也大于偏保守右的个体。关切的上升表明，气候事件加剧而非缓解了环境态度上的政治极化。我还发现，没有证据表明接触气候变化新闻能够解释所观察到的关切上的政治极化。这些模式与沿党派界线进行的动机性推理相一致，即动机性推理塑造了对气候灾害的差异化反应。相比之下，我没有发现对提高碳税支持度存在类似模式，这表明关切的上升未必转化为对气候政策的支持。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

title: Who is concerned about climate change when forests are burning? Evidence from Swedish forest fires
title_zh: 当森林燃烧时，谁在关注气候变化？来自瑞典森林火灾的证据

abstract: By controlling the scarcity of an offshore parallel currency, policymakers can manage capital flows and steer the exchange rate. This is an alternative policy to setting the rate of a Tobin tax. However, its fiscal implications are distinct, and this paper lays them out. Having a parallel currency creates both seigniorage and liquidity revenues. The two revenues have different sizes and different Laffer curves, both of which vary with the regime for the exchange rate, with liquidity policies, and with the size of the offshore market. Quantitatively, the fiscal footprint of offshore money management is small and the Laffer curve is flat, boosting the chances that it can be used independently of fiscal pressures.
abstract_zh: 通过控制离岸平行货币的稀缺性，政策制定者能够管理资本流动并引导汇率。这是设定托宾税率的一种替代政策。然而，其财政影响截然不同，本文对此进行了阐述。拥有平行货币会同时产生铸币税收入和流动性收入。这两种收入规模不同，拉弗曲线也各异，且均随汇率制度、流动性政策以及离岸市场规模的变化而变化。从数量上看，离岸货币管理的财政足迹较小，拉弗曲线较为平坦，这增加了其能够在不受财政压力影响的情况下独立使用的可能性。
title: The Fiscal Implications of Parallel Currencies

abstract: Subjective well-being rankings are widely used to target social protection programs, yet their ability to capture relative welfare and wealth remains debated. This study compares three commonly used subjective ranking methods: self-, peer-, and elite-based poverty rankings, against consumption- and wealth-based measures using a large household survey in Ethiopia, where about 20 households per village were ranked from most to least “needy” by themselves, their peers, and community leaders. We assess concordance between subjective and conventional welfare rankings and explore sources of divergence. Subjective rankings align more with relative wealth than consumption and with total rather than per capita welfare, suggesting they overlook household composition. Among the three subjective ranking methods, elite-based rankings best capture conventional measures, although overall concordance between subjective and welfare-based rankings remains weak. Subjective rankings also better reflect relative deprivation among households exposed to covariate shocks. A composite index combining all three modestly improves concordance with standard metrics. We find suggestive evidence that information asymmetry, favoritism, and welfare dynamics partly explain discrepancies between subjective rankings and conventional welfare measures. These findings offer important insights to improve targeting in data-scarce settings.
abstract_zh: 主观幸福感排名被广泛用于瞄准社会保护项目，但其捕捉相对福利与财富的能力仍存争议。本研究利用埃塞俄比亚一项大型家庭调查，比较了三种常用的主观排名方法：自我、同伴和精英为基础的贫困排名，并将其与基于消费和财富的测量指标进行对照。在该调查中，每个村庄约20户家庭由自身、同伴和社区领袖从“最贫困”到“最不贫困”进行排名。我们评估主观排名与传统福利排名之间的一致性，并探讨分歧来源。主观排名与相对财富的一致性高于与消费的一致性，且与总福利而非人均福利更为一致，表明其忽视了家庭构成。在三种主观排名方法中，精英为基础的排名最能捕捉传统测量指标，尽管主观排名与基于福利的排名之间总体一致性仍然较弱。主观排名也更好地反映了遭受共同冲击家庭的相对剥夺状况。将三种方法结合而成的综合指数适度提高了与标准指标的一致性。我们发现提示性证据表明，信息不对称、偏袒和福利动态部分解释了主观排名与传统福利测量之间的差异。这些发现为在数据稀缺环境中改进瞄准提供了重要启示。
title: Perceived need and measured well-being: How well do subjective rankings capture relative poverty?
title_zh: 感知需求与测量福祉：主观排名在多大程度上能反映相对贫困？

abstract: We study how Chinese macroeconomic surprises affect global financial markets. We exploit forecast errors around key data releases and changes in asset prices in a 60-minute window around those releases. A positive Industrial Production (IP) surprise leads to an immediate increase in Chinese and Asia-Pacific stock returns, global long-term yields, and commodity prices highly demanded by China. A complementary identification strategy, which builds on different time-zones, confirms positive spillovers to international equity markets, with stronger effects in emerging economies. Our results highlight the role of both Hedging Premia and Growth Expectations in driving asset price comovement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究中国宏观经济意外如何影响全球金融市场。我们利用关键数据发布前后的预测误差以及这些发布前后60分钟窗口内的资产价格变化。正向的工业增加值（IP）意外会导致中国及亚太地区股票收益率、全球长期收益率，以及中国高需求商品价格立即上升。一种基于不同时区的互补识别策略，证实了对国际股票市场的正向溢出效应，且在新兴经济体中影响更强。我们的结果凸显了对冲溢价和增长预期在驱动资产价格联动中的作用。
